title: test(spec): the connector-author-shape compile test carries its own 180 s timeout
body:
Fixes #22929
Clause-②: no

> ~~Held out of the merge queue by #22949.~~ Released 2026-10-12: #22949 closed, and `main` was merged into this branch with the net diff unchanged. The seat queues it once the new head is green and its remaining pre-queue items are met.

## What changed

One file, `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-author-shape.test.ts`, +14 / -1: the `it` named `compiles every full connector example verbatim, import line included` now passes `180_000` as its own timeout, with a comment carrying the measured figures and the reasoning for the bound. Test-only. The package-wide `testTimeout: 60_000` in `packages/spec/vitest.config.ts` is untouched, and the test is neither skipped nor split.

## Why 180 s

- CI, `Test Core (1/6)`, as filed on the card: 55,680 ms on `main` (one cached replay, not three readings) and 61,767 ms on a cold spec re-run on PR #22922, which timed out at 60,000 ms. I could not re-read the job log from this container (the log blob host is not reachable through the proxy); the check run itself confirms that job failed in the `packages/spec` `pnpm run test` step, and the figures here are the card's.
- Local, same test, `--maxWorkers=2` on a shared box: 13,796 ms before the change and 10,969 ms after.
- 180,000 ms is about 2.9x the cold CI reading and 3.2x the cached one. A hung compile still fails inside three minutes. It is also the figure `shared/alias-integrity.test.ts` already gives its own heavy `beforeAll`.

## Evidence the timeout is the one that governs (ablation, one-off, nothing kept)

Direction stated before running: with the own timeout removed and the global forced down to 2,000 ms on the command line, the `it` goes red; restored, it goes green under the same forced global.

| leg | command tail | result |
|---|---|---|
| ablated (`}, 180_000);` replaced by `});`, mutation proven on disk by anchor count 1 to 0 and blob change) | `vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --testTimeout=2000 ...connector-author-shape.test.ts` | `Test timed out in 2000ms` on the compile `it`, 10 other tests pass |
| restored (blob equals HEAD blob `88e0e6551c93`, `git diff HEAD` empty) | same command | 11 of 11 pass, compile `it` 12,452 ms under the 2,000 ms global |

The observed direction is the predicted one (red, then green). The test subject here is the test file itself, resolved from `src`, so there is no `dist` leg to prove.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/integration/connector-author-shape.test.ts` at `57d5074ff`: 11 passed, compile `it` 10,969 ms.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 77 commands for this change set; all 77 were run at `57d5074ff` with exit codes recorded before any pipe and reconciled with `--ran`: 76 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (prerequisite: it reads the built `dist` of 88 other packages, which needs a whole-workspace `pnpm build`). A test file enters no package's emitted output, and `Build Core` in CI covers it. Two other gates that first exited 3 for an unbuilt prerequisite (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:lean-entry-closure`) were rerun after a targeted build and exited 0.
- Not measured here: the card's second half of "Done when", a cold `Test Core` shard running it green, which is CI's reading of this PR.
- `main` moved four commits after the branch point (`da9c2bf2f`); none touches the test, `docs/SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md`, `packages/spec/src/integration/` or the vitest config. `main` was not merged in.

## Publishes nothing

`npm pack --dry-run` on `@objectstack/spec` lists 2,079 files: 0 are test files or this test, with `src/integration/connector.zod.ts` present as the positive control; a search of `dist` for the test's title finds 0 files, and for `ConnectorSchema` finds files. No changeset is owed, and `skip-changeset` applies.

## Acceptance notes

Nothing out of scope was found.
